items.title: 10.11 Electrode potentials (oxidation aur reduction ki aasani) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.11, printed pages 224-225.

blocks.text: Redox amal ke doran mukhtalif oxidation states wali do kimiyai taur par juri species ke darmiyan redox equilibrium maujood hota hai. Jab metal ko us ke ions ke solution mein rakha jaye to metal aur solution ke metal ions ke darmiyan ek electric potential (voltage) qaim hota hai; yeh electrode potential hai, aur yeh kisi madde ke oxidation ya reduction ki aasani batata hai. Jab copper ki rod us ke ions ke aabi solution mein rakhi jaye to equilibrium Cu2+(aq) + 2e- se Cu(s) maujood hota hai, do mukhalif reactions ke saath: rod ke metal atoms metal ions ke taur par solution mein jate hain, electrode ki satah par electrons chhorte hue (Cu se Cu2+ + 2e-), aur solution ke ions rod se electrons le kar us ki satah par metal atoms ke taur par jam jate hain (Cu2+ + 2e- se Cu). Redox equilibrium tab qaim hota hai jab electron hasil karne ki rate electron khone ki rate ke barabar ho.

Copper jaise ghair-faal (unreactive) metals ke liye equilibrium doosre metals ke muqable zyada daen hota hai: Cu2+ ions nisbatan aasani se reduce hote aur electrons le kar copper banate hain. Vanadium jaise faal (reactive) metals ke liye equilibrium V2+(aq) + 2e- se V(s) zyada baen hota hai: V2+ ions nisbatan mushkil se reduce hote aur electrons bohat kam lete hain. Apne ions ke solutions mein rakhe mukhtalif metals ke liye equilibrium ki position mukhtalif hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Faal metal ke liye satah ke do mukhalif reactions mein se kaun sa ghalib hota hai, aur rod kis nishan ka charge hasil karti hai?
blocks.explanation: Faal metal ke atoms ions ke taur par rod se zyada aasani se nikalte hain jitna ions wapas aate hain, to equilibrium tak halne wala reaction ghalib rehta hai; peechhe reh jane wale electrons rod ko solution ke muqable manfi charge dete hain, aur metal jitna zyada faal, us ka electrode potential utna zyada manfi.

items: Electrode potential: metal aur solution mein us ke ions ke darmiyan voltage, oxidation ya reduction ki aasani ka paimana; equilibrium M2+ + 2e- = M jab electron hasil aur khona barabar hon.
Copper: equilibrium daen, Cu2+ aasani se reduce. Vanadium: equilibrium baen, V2+ mushkil se reduce.
